newsitem.title: USA: Disney chief Michael Eisner signs book deal.
newsitem.headline: Disney chief Michael Eisner signs book deal.

text.p: Walt Disney Co chairman Michael Eisner, who brought the company to unparallled prosperity and media influence, wants to tell all.

Random House announced Thursday that Eisner will write a book about his personal experiences and ideas on business in collaboration with journalist Tony Schwartz, who co-wrote Donald Trump's No. 1 bestseller, "The Art of the Deal."
The book will be personally edited by Random House publisher Harry Evans, who also edited Colin Powell's bestselling memoirs and Richard Nixon's last book.
The as yet untitled book will be published in the fall and will also deal with Eisner's views on the entertainment business, risk-taking and nuturing and protecting the Disney brand.
He will receive no advance or guarenteed payment for the book and its royaltiies will be paid into a special fund for the education of the children of Disney employees based on merit and need.

Eisner has been chairman of Disney since 1984 and under him the company's revenues climbed from $2 billion to $50 billion a year. In 1995, he engineered the aquisition of CapCities/ABC for $19 billion.
